note: Fixed before any model run (decision-criteria.md). #1843: whether the one asc sentence (a change that writes or modifies a spec document reads the writing rules first) brings the writing rules to the Agent when it rewrites the existing FN-003 / SCR-005 (s-1), and does not bring the rules or templates into requests that do not write a spec (n-2 translation, n-3 a question about the current spec). The three cases are those of #1840 (prompts, fixtures, writes and answer markers unchanged); the differences are listed in the case notes (expectReads, forbidReads, writes.requireFiles). Prompts are natural sentences without Skill names or file paths.
pathBase: Tool paths are resolved against the session cwd from the init event (the sample project root), normalised, and matched relative to that root; a path outside the root never matches.
markerTextNote: #1840 review M1: the markers are matched on the answer and the text of every file the trial wrote (score.mjs scoreRun).
markerBaseNote: #1840 re-review High: before the markers are matched, the lines of a written file equal to a line (trimmed) of a file that existed before the trial are left out: the installed templates (.agent-skill-chain/templates/ and its managed-runtime copy, at the fixture's HEAD) and the earlier text of the written file itself (score.mjs baseLinesFor). A copied template, or one with a row filled in, adds only the lines the trial wrote. w-2 writes.requireWithoutBase applies the same to its require patterns.

reads.pattern: ^\.agent-skill-chain/(managed-runtime/v05/)?templates/specs/details/(04_機能/01_個別機能|05_画面/02_個別画面)テンプレート\.md$

reportNote: Reported per trial, never used for a level: which templates were read (the rules, the feature / screen templates, any template), whether the workspace reference was read (the path the s-1 trials of #1840 took), whether the answer mentions the ASC CLI start or Bash, and every file written.

cases.prompt:
会員登録機能（FN-003）と会員登録画面（SCR-005）の仕様書を、次の変更に合わせて書き直してほしい。

- これまで会員登録はメールアドレスだけだったが、今回から電話番号でも登録できるようにした。
- 登録時に送る確認コードは6桁の数字。有効期限は以前は10分だったが、問い合わせが多かったので15分に延ばした。
- 確認コードを5回続けて間違えると、その登録手続きを30分ロックする（これは前から変わらない）。
- 電話番号はE.164形式で受け付ける。
- 画面では、登録手段を「メールアドレス」「電話番号」のタブで切り替える。前はメールアドレスの入力欄だけだった。
- 確認コードが期限切れのときは「確認コードの有効期限が切れました。もう一度送信してください」と表示し、再送信ボタンを出す。
- この変更は2026-11-20の打合せで顧客の佐藤さん（役割：業務責任者）が決めた。
